en-US.name: WOA: Wake On Alexa
en-US.summary: Turn on your computer with Alexa using Wake on LAN. Free and open source.
en-US.description:
Turn on your computer with your voice, from any Echo or from the Alexa app, even when you are away from home.

WOA uses Alexa's built-in Wake on LAN support: your Echo, on the same network as the computer, sends the magic packet. No extra device, app or open port is needed at home. WOA is free and open source (github.com/ccccri/woa).

How to use it:
1. Enable the skill and link your Amazon account.
2. Open https://ccccri.github.io/woa/setup.html, sign in with the same Amazon account and add your computers (name and MAC address).
3. Say "Alexa, discover devices".

Requirements: an Echo device on the same local network as the computer, and Wake on LAN enabled on the computer (BIOS/UEFI and network card). WOA can only turn computers on: it cannot turn them off or report whether they are on.

it-IT.name: WOA: Wake On Alexa
it-IT.summary: Accendi il computer con Alexa tramite Wake on LAN. Gratis e open source.
it-IT.description:
Accendi il computer con la voce, da qualunque Echo o dall'app Alexa, anche quando sei fuori casa.

WOA usa il supporto Wake on LAN integrato in Alexa: il tuo Echo, nella stessa rete del computer, invia il magic packet. In casa non servono dispositivi, app o porte aperte. WOA è gratuito e open source (github.com/ccccri/woa).

Come si usa:
1. Attiva la skill e collega il tuo account Amazon.
2. Apri https://ccccri.github.io/woa/setup.html, accedi con lo stesso account Amazon e aggiungi i computer (nome e indirizzo MAC).
3. Di' "Alexa, cerca dispositivi".

Requisiti: un Echo nella stessa rete locale del computer e il Wake on LAN attivo sul computer (BIOS/UEFI e scheda di rete). WOA può solo accendere i computer: non li spegne e non sa dire se sono accesi.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
WOA is a Smart Home skill that wakes computers with the Alexa.WakeOnLANController interface. It has no voice model of its own; it uses the standard Smart Home "turn on" utterances.

Setup for testing:
1. Enable the skill and complete account linking (Login with Amazon, scope profile:user_id).
2. Open https://ccccri.github.io/woa/setup.html and sign in with the SAME Amazon account used for account linking.
3. Add a computer, e.g. name "test computer", MAC "C8:7F:54:0B:30:C5" (any valid unicast MAC is accepted). The device is pushed to Alexa with AddOrUpdateReport; you can also say "Alexa, discover devices".

What to test:
- "Alexa, turn on test computer": the skill answers TurnOn with a DeferredResponse, then sends Alexa.WakeOnLANController.WakeUp and the final Alexa.Response to the event gateway. A supported Echo on the same LAN broadcasts the Wake on LAN packet to the MAC address. A real wake-up requires a Wake-on-LAN capable computer on the tester's network.
- "Alexa, turn off test computer": not supported by design (Wake on LAN can only power on); the skill returns NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_CURRENT_MODE.
- Removing the computer on the setup page sends DeleteReport, so it disappears from the Alexa app.
- "Delete all my data" on the setup page removes all stored data.

The power state is not retrievable (the skill cannot know whether the computer is on), so the device declares powerState with retrievable=false. ReportState returns EndpointHealth connectivity only.

Source code: https://github.com/ccccri/woa
